sentences.text: This animal is recognized by a bulge near the second sacral vertebra, elongated rear limb bones, and triangular tail vertebrae.
De Saez described the genus in 1928, placing it among extinct mesoeucrocodylians within the group Notosuchia.
Although originally classified as a goniopholidid, later studies redescribed it as a neosuchian or notosuchian, with a 2017 analysis recovering it as a primitive notosuchian.
Fossils from the Bajo de la Carpa Formation date to the Santonian stage, meaning the creature lived approximately 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago.
